audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Levels 3, 4-5 and First item to Kled and Level 6 to Skill, while every one of those stages' whys describes Cho'Gath winning — including whys[2], which literally says 'this stage belongs to Cho per the cross-lock'.
audit.why: Packet levelChart reads Kled,Kled,Cho'Gath,Cho'Gath,Cho'Gath,Cho'Gath,Kled and the already-audited mirror recorded exactly that chart with Cho ratings 4,3,6,7,7,7,4. Feral Scream's silence and Rupture's knockup peel Kled's E off, and Feast stacks out-pace his percent-health Q.
audit.corrected: Levels 3, 4-5, 6 and First item flipped to Cho'Gath in both layers; Kled ratings inverted to 4/10, 3/10, 3/10, 3/10 to mirror the opponent's 6,7,7,7. Levels 1-2 and 2+ items stay Kled, matching both the mirror and the whys.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns on any spike; the tracked ability was described only as 'Telegraphed'.
audit.why: Rupture is 6s flat at 950 range — longer than Kled's 800-range Bear Trap, so Cho can poke from outside Kled's pin. Feral Scream is 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s. Feast is 80/70/60s.
audit.corrected: 6s and 950 range in dosFull[0].d, report[5].t and breakdown.cooldowns; Feral Scream's 11s and 300-range cone in breakdown.cooldowns and dontsFull[1].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page told the reader to build Plated Steelcaps and treat this as a stat-check while never stating that Feast is true damage on a percentage of health — resistances are the wrong answer to it. The silence's range and effect on Kled's re-cast E were also unstated.
audit.why: Riot's R text: 'Devours an enemy unit, dealing a high amount of true damage', with trueDamage and percentHealth both derived. Armour and MR do not reduce it, which is the interaction the missing-interactions file flags as resistances-invalidated. Feral Scream is a 300-range cone silence — inside it Kled cannot re-cast Jousting to dash back out, which is the specific way his combo dies.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[2].d states the true damage and that armour and MR do nothing; dontsFull[1].d and breakdown.cooldowns state the silence range and what it cuts.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[2] shipped an unfinished editorial note to the reader: 'Wait — this stage belongs to Cho per the cross-lock, but...'.
audit.why: That is internal reasoning about the chart, not matchup advice, and it appears on a paying user's page.
audit.corrected: Rewritten as real advice about Rupture into Feral Scream interrupting the combo, at the same length.

edits.before: Wait — this stage belongs to Cho per the cross-lock, but your E-W-E re-engage burst genuinely shreds his pre-stack HP; respect his Q knockup into W silence that can interrupt the combo.
edits.after: Cho takes this stage back: your E-W-E burst still shreds his pre-stack HP, but Rupture's knockup every 6s into Feral Scream's silence interrupts the combo and he only has to land one.

edits.before: Telegraphed. Dodge it and Q-pull. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Rupture is 6s, 950 range, and knocks up — sidestep it, then Q-pull him.

edits.before: That is Cho'Gath's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Rupture knocks you up and slows — it is 6s, so he can afford to throw it often.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Feral Scream silences in a 300 cone — your re-E dies inside it.

edits.before: Giving away the dismount for free — mounted HP is a resource; spending it on poke instead of all-ins loses the lane.
edits.after: Feast is true damage on a percentage of health, so armour and MR do nothing — deny the stacks and never fight it low.

edits.before: - Cho'Gath Rupture: matchup-defining — Telegraphed. Dodge it and Q-pull. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Cho'Gath Rupture: matchup-defining — 6s, 950 range, telegraphed knockup. Dodge it and Q-pull. - Feral Scream: 11s silence in a 300 cone, it cuts your re-E. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.

edits.before: Track Cho'Gath's Rupture (Knockup): Telegraphed. Dodge it and Q-pull. When it is down — Q-pull + W him.
edits.after: Track Rupture: 6s, 950 range, telegraphed knockup. Dodge it, then Q-pull and W him at 800 range.

notes: whys[2] contained a leaked editorial aside ('this stage belongs to Cho per the cross-lock') that was live on the page — replaced with real advice. Note the range asymmetry that the mirror also recorded: Rupture reaches 950 while Bear Trap on a Rope only reaches 800, so Cho pokes from outside Kled's pin. Cho's Q carries a derived 'grounding' flag that Riot's description does not support (it pops up, damages and slows) — no grounding claim written. The full layer still spells the Q 'Beartrap' in several fields; Riot's name is Bear Trap on a Rope, same issue the mirror flagged champion-wide.
